vulnerability.title: Emacs Backup Artifact Disclosure and PHP Array Type Juggling
vulnerability.root_cause: The web server serves uncompiled editor backup files (.php~) containing raw source code, and backend authentication relies on sha1() which returns NULL on array parameters, allowing strict comparison bypass (NULL === NULL).
vulnerability.impact: Complete authentication bypass and unauthorized disclosure of sensitive server files.

remediation.primary: Configure web server rules to deny access to editor backup extensions and enforce strict input parameter type validation with password_verify().
remediation.standard: OWASP Secure Configuration Guide / CWE-530 Mitigation

vulnerability.title: Cleartext Key Disclosure and Keystream-XOR Blockchain Obfuscation
vulnerability.root_cause: The generation tool outputs both the 32-byte encryption key and the ciphertext into the distributed artifact, using a static 16-byte repeated SHA-256 keystream without IV or MAC.
vulnerability.impact: Total loss of confidentiality; instant mathematical plaintext and flag recovery via symmetric XOR inversion.

remediation.primary: Enforce strict separation between cryptographic keys and encrypted artifacts using KMS/HSM, and replace ad-hoc XOR logic with authenticated ciphers like AES-256-GCM.

vulnerability.title: Rust Unsafe Block Boundary Omission for Raw Pointer Slicing
vulnerability.root_cause: Attempting to invoke std::slice::from_raw_parts without an enclosing unsafe { ... } block violates the Rust compiler safety contract, causing build failure under error[E0133].
vulnerability.impact: Compilation abort; binary cannot be generated or executed until sound memory boundary encapsulations are restored.

remediation.primary: Wrap raw pointer dereferencing and slice creation within a minimal, strictly validated unsafe block with documented safety invariants.
